verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בּוֹקֵ֥ק הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֽוֹלְקָ֑הּ וְעִוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֖יץ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh Yah·weh bō·w·qêq hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇō·wl·qāh wə·‘iw·wāh p̄ā·ne·hā wə·hê·p̄îṣ yō·šə·ḇe·hā
verses.literal: Behold the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה כָעָם֙ כַּכֹּהֵ֔ן כַּעֶ֙בֶד֙ כַּֽאדֹנָ֔יו כַּשִּׁפְחָ֖ה כַּגְּבִרְתָּ֑הּ כַּקּוֹנֶה֙ כַּמּוֹכֵ֔ר כַּמַּלְוֶה֙ כַּלֹּוֶ֔ה כַּנֹּשֶׁ֕ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נֹשֶׁ֥א בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵā·‘ām kak·kō·hên ka·‘e·ḇeḏ ka·ḏō·nāw kaš·šip̄·ḥāh kag·gə·ḇir·tāh kaq·qō·w·neh kam·mō·w·ḵêr kam·mal·weh kal·lō·weh kan·nō·šeh ka·’ă·šer nō·še ḇōw
verses.literal: - people and priest alike servant and master maid and mistress buyer and seller lender and borrower . . . - creditor and debtor

verses.original: הָאָ֖רֶץ הִבּ֧וֹק׀ תִּבּ֛וֹק וְהִבּ֣וֹז׀ תִּבּ֑וֹז כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶת־ הַזֶּֽה׃ הַדָּבָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ hib·bō·wq tib·bō·wq wə·hib·bō·wz tib·bō·wz kî Yah·weh dib·ber ’eṯ- haz·zeh had·dā·ḇār
verses.literal: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered For the LORD has spoken - this word

verses.original: הָאָ֔רֶץ אָבְלָ֤ה נָֽבְלָה֙ תֵּבֵ֑ל אֻמְלְלָ֥ה נָבְלָ֖ה מְר֥וֹם עַם־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ אֻמְלָ֖לוּ
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ ’ā·ḇə·lāh nā·ḇə·lāh tê·ḇêl ’um·lə·lāh nā·ḇə·lāh mə·rō·wm ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ ’um·lā·lū
verses.literal: The earth mourns and withers the world languishes and fades the exalted - of the earth waste away

verses.original: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ חָנְפָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּֽי־ עָבְר֤וּ תוֹרֹת֙ חָ֣לְפוּ חֹ֔ק הֵפֵ֖רוּ עוֹלָֽם׃ בְּרִ֥ית
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ ḥā·nə·p̄āh ta·ḥaṯ yō·šə·ḇe·hā kî- ‘ā·ḇə·rū ṯō·w·rōṯ ḥā·lə·p̄ū ḥōq hê·p̄ê·rū ‘ō·w·lām bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: The earth is defiled by its people - they have transgressed the laws they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן אָלָה֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֶ֔רֶץ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וַֽיֶּאְשְׁמ֖וּ אֶ֔רֶץ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי עַל־ כֵּ֗ן חָרוּ֙ אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִזְעָֽר׃ וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ā·lāh ’ā·ḵə·lāh ’e·reṣ yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh way·ye’·šə·mū ’e·reṣ yō·šə·ḇê ‘al- kên ḥā·rū ’ĕ·nō·wōš miz·‘ār wə·niš·’ar
verses.literal: Therefore . . . a curse has consumed the earth and its inhabitants must bear the guilt the earth’s dwellers - - have been burned and only a few . . . survive

verses.original: תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אָבַ֥ל גָ֑פֶן אֻמְלְלָה־ כָּל־ שִׂמְחֵי־ לֵֽב׃ נֶאֶנְח֖וּ
verses.transliteration: tî·rō·wōš ’ā·ḇal ḡā·p̄en ’um·lə·lāh- kāl- śim·ḥê- lêḇ ne·’en·ḥū
verses.literal: The new wine dries up the vine withers All the merrymakers . . . now groan

verses.original: מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ תֻּפִּ֔ים שָׁבַת֙ שְׁא֣וֹן עַלִּיזִ֑ים חָדַ֖ל מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ כִּנּֽוֹר׃ שָׁבַ֖ת
verses.transliteration: mə·śō·wś tup·pîm šā·ḇaṯ šə·’ō·wn ‘al·lî·zîm ḥā·ḏal mə·śō·wś kin·nō·wr šā·ḇaṯ
verses.literal: The joyful tambourines have ceased the noise of revelers has stopped the joyful harp is silent

verses.original: לֹ֣א בַּשִּׁ֖יר יִשְׁתּוּ־ יָ֑יִן שֵׁכָ֖ר יֵמַ֥ר לְשֹׁתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lō baš·šîr yiš·tū- yā·yin šê·ḵār yê·mar lə·šō·ṯāw
verses.literal: They no longer sing and drink wine strong drink is bitter to those who consume it

verses.original: קִרְיַת־ תֹּ֑הוּ נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה כָּל־ בַּ֖יִת סֻגַּ֥ר מִבּֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: qir·yaṯ- tō·hū niš·bə·rāh kāl- ba·yiṯ sug·gar mib·bō·w
verses.literal: The city of chaos is shattered every house is closed to entry

verses.original: בַּֽחוּצ֑וֹת צְוָחָ֥ה עַל־ הַיַּ֖יִן כָּל־ שִׂמְחָ֔ה עָֽרְבָה֙ מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ גָּלָ֖ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ṣə·wā·ḥāh ‘al- hay·ya·yin kāl- śim·ḥāh ‘ā·rə·ḇāh mə·śō·wś gā·lāh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: In the streets they cry out for wine All joy turns to gloom rejoicing is exiled from the land

verses.original: בָּעִ֖יר נִשְׁאַ֥ר שַׁמָּ֑ה שָֽׁעַר׃ יֻכַּת־ וּשְׁאִיָּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: bā·‘îr niš·’ar šam·māh šā·‘ar yuk·kaṯ- ū·šə·’î·yāh
verses.literal: The city is left in ruins its gate is reduced to rubble

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יִהְיֶ֛ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים כְּנֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת כְּעוֹלֵלֹ֖ת אִם־ כָּלָ֥ה בָצִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh yih·yeh bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘am·mîm kə·nō·qep̄ za·yiṯ kə·‘ō·w·lê·lōṯ ’im- kā·lāh ḇā·ṣîr
verses.literal: So . . . will it be on the earth [and] among the nations like a harvested olive tree like a gleaning after . . . a grape harvest

verses.original: הֵ֛מָּה יִשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם יָרֹ֑נּוּ מִיָּֽם׃ צָהֲל֖וּ בִּגְא֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yiś·’ū qō·w·lām yā·rōn·nū mî·yām ṣā·hă·lū biḡ·’ō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: They raise their voices they shout for joy from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD

verses.original: עַל־ כַּבְּד֣וּ יְהוָ֑ה כֵּ֥ן בָּאֻרִ֖ים שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס בְּאִיֵּ֣י הַיָּ֔ם
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kab·bə·ḏū Yah·weh kên bā·’u·rîm šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl bə·’î·yê hay·yām
verses.literal: Therefore glorify the LORD . . . in the east Extol the name of the LORD the God of Israel in the islands of the sea

verses.original: מִכְּנַ֨ף הָאָ֜רֶץ שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ זְמִרֹ֤ת צְבִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֔יק וָאֹמַ֛ר רָזִי־ לִ֥י רָֽזִי־ לִ֖י א֣וֹי לִ֑י בֹּגְדִ֣ים בָּגָ֔דוּ בּוֹגְדִ֖ים וּבֶ֥גֶד בָּגָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kə·nap̄ hā·’ā·reṣ šā·ma‘·nū zə·mi·rōṯ ṣə·ḇî laṣ·ṣad·dîq wā·’ō·mar rā·zî- lî rā·zî- lî ’ō·w lî bō·ḡə·ḏîm bā·ḡā·ḏū bō·wḡ·ḏîm ū·ḇe·ḡeḏ bā·ḡā·ḏū
verses.literal: From the ends of the earth we hear singing Glory to the Righteous One But I said I am wasting away I am wasting away Woe is me The treacherous betray the treacherous deal in treachery

verses.original: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: pa·ḥaḏ wā·p̄a·ḥaṯ wā·p̄āḥ ‘ā·le·ḵā yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Terror and pit and snare await you O dweller of the earth

verses.original: וְֽ֠הָיָה הַנָּ֞ס מִקּ֤וֹל הַפַּ֙חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־ הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעוֹלֶה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־ אֲרֻבּ֤וֹת מִמָּרוֹם֙ נִפְתָּ֔חוּ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃ וַֽיִּרְעֲשׁ֖וּ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh han·nās miq·qō·wl hap·pa·ḥaḏ yip·pōl ’el- hap·pa·ḥaṯ wə·hā·‘ō·w·leh mit·tō·wḵ hap·pa·ḥaṯ yil·lā·ḵêḏ bap·pāḥ kî- ’ă·rub·bō·wṯ mim·mā·rō·wm nip̄·tā·ḥū mō·ws·ḏê ’ā·reṣ way·yir·‘ă·šū
verses.literal: - Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare For the windows of heaven are open and the foundations of the earth are shaken

verses.original: הָאָ֑רֶץ רֹ֥עָה הִֽתְרֹעֲעָ֖ה אֶ֔רֶץ פּ֤וֹר הִֽתְפּוֹרְרָה֙ אָֽרֶץ׃ מ֥וֹט הִֽתְמוֹטְטָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ rō·‘āh hiṯ·rō·‘ă·‘āh ’e·reṣ pō·wr hiṯ·pō·wr·rāh ’ā·reṣ mō·wṭ hiṯ·mō·wṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: The earth is utterly broken apart . . . the earth is split open . . . the earth is shaken violently . . .

verses.original: אֶ֙רֶץ֙ נ֣וֹעַ תָּנ֤וּעַ כַּשִּׁכּ֔וֹר וְהִֽתְנוֹדְדָ֖ה כַּמְּלוּנָ֑ה פִּשְׁעָ֔הּ וְכָבַ֤ד עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ וְנָפְלָ֖ה וְלֹא־ קֽוּם׃ס תֹסִ֥יף
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ nō·w·a‘ tā·nū·a‘ kaš·šik·kō·wr wə·hiṯ·nō·wḏ·ḏāh kam·mə·lū·nāh piš·‘āh wə·ḵā·ḇaḏ ‘ā·le·hā wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh wə·lō- qūm ṯō·sîp̄
verses.literal: The earth staggers . . . like a drunkard and sways like a shack Earth’s rebellion weighs it down . . . and it falls never to rise again

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם יְהוָ֛ה יִפְקֹ֧ד עַל־ צְבָ֥א הַמָּר֖וֹם בַּמָּר֑וֹם וְעַל־ מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־ הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm Yah·weh yip̄·qōḏ ‘al- ṣə·ḇā ham·mā·rō·wm bam·mā·rō·wm wə·‘al- mal·ḵê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ‘al- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: - In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven above . . . and the kings of the earth below . . .

verses.original: וְאֻסְּפ֨וּ אֲסֵפָ֤ה אַסִּיר֙ עַל־ בּ֔וֹר וְסֻגְּר֖וּ עַל־ מַסְגֵּ֑ר יִפָּקֵֽדוּ׃ וּמֵרֹ֥ב יָמִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: wə·’us·sə·p̄ū ’ă·sê·p̄āh ’as·sîr ‘al- bō·wr wə·sug·gə·rū ‘al- mas·gêr yip·pā·qê·ḏū ū·mê·rōḇ yā·mîm
verses.literal: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days

verses.original: הַלְּבָנָ֔ה וְחָֽפְרָה֙ הַֽחַמָּ֑ה וּבוֹשָׁ֖ה כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת מָלַ֞ךְ בְּהַ֤ר צִיּוֹן֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְנֶ֥גֶד זְקֵנָ֖יו כָּבֽוֹד׃פ
verses.transliteration: hal·lə·ḇā·nāh wə·ḥā·p̄ə·rāh ha·ḥam·māh ū·ḇō·wō·šāh kî- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mā·laḵ bə·har ṣî·yō·wn ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim wə·ne·ḡeḏ zə·qê·nāw kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem and before His elders with great glory
